title: Custom Soundboard
description: A fun soundboard app where you can add, play, edit, and delete sounds with a simple interface.
how_to_play:
1. Click 'Add New Sound' to add a sound file.
2. Enter a button name or leave default.
3. Click a button to play the sound.
4. Use volume slider to adjust volume.
5. Check 'Loop Sounds' to loop playback.
6. Right-click a button to edit or delete the sound.

Tips:
- Keep your sounds short for quick playback.
- Organize your buttons for easy access.
